title: Model SBI as a multi-rail financial group; separate XRP incentives, exchange liquidity, JPYSC collateral, OUSD and trust custody
decision: Resolve SBIC by legal entity, not acronym resemblance: SBIC East Japan is the ChatGPT-seminar entity; SBICAH GK is a separate SBI Holdings acquisition vehicle represented by SBI Crypto Asset Holdings Co., Ltd.; SBI Clearing Trust is a separate trust company.

Represent SBI's XRP exposure as multiple distinct channels: Bitbank XRP/JPY spot market, SBI VC Trade, Visa card points, START bond rewards, RLUSD distribution, and SBI Ripple Asia's XRPL startup support.
Keep JPYSC issuance, lending applications, short-term JGB reserve assets and trust custody as separate measures. Do not add JPYSC lending applications to issued supply.
Keep JPYSC/OUSD interoperability and BlackRock tokenized-MMF integration as PoC/MOU-stage relationships until a chain, production deployment and transaction data are verified.
Treat Open Standard as a multi-party network that includes Coinbase as founder and Ripple as a reported broader participant; do not treat OUSD as a Ripple product or infer an XRPL deployment.
Do not infer Circle is an Open Standard partner from Coinbase's participation. Circle is not listed among the five founding partners in the cited launch material.
Keep SBI's XRP incentive programs as distribution mechanisms, not measured XRP net purchases; require aggregate credited quantities and corresponding market/custody data before model admission.
Treat the Bitbank XRP/JPY market snapshot as indicative only until a timestamped historical depth/volume series is assembled.
Preserve the Binance PoR XRP crosswalk as unknown until the official October 1 address file is downloaded and all five source addresses plus the XRP-BF2 backing address are compared.
rationale: SBI's October 1 Bitbank acquisition, May XRP card, February START bond, June RLUSD listing, USDC distribution, XRPL startup support and October JPYSC/Open Standard/BlackRock developments establish a broad digital-asset strategy.

The JPYSC structure provides concrete reserve/collateral evidence: JPY 20.1B issuance, JPY 1B short-term JGB allocation and JPY 6.9B lending applications as of September 7; the lending figure is not supply.
The October 29 trust merger is a planned consolidation, not yet effective and not a disclosed XRP custody mandate.
Coinbase and Ripple participation in Open Standard creates shared network exposure, while Circle remains a separate USDC issuer and not a listed founding partner.
The latest ledger validator failure was caused by a wrong archive shard record_type envelope, not by source IDs or blob hashes; corrected copies preserve the malformed originals.
rejected_shortcuts: Do not equate SBIC East Japan with SBICAH or SBI Clearing Trust.
Do not treat SBI START bond XRP rewards as recurring or as proof of market buying.
Do not treat JPYSC lending applications as additional issued supply.
Do not treat JPYSC/OUSD PoC or BlackRock MMF MOU as live production settlement.
Do not treat Ripple's reported Open Standard membership as an OUSD issuer role or XRPL deployment.
Do not infer Circle displacement from Coinbase's OUSD participation.
Do not infer XRP-specific custody from SBI Clearing Trust's general crypto trust business.
required_next_evidence: Verify the corrected archive shards with the exact-head validator and fail-closed gate.
Retrieve the official Binance October 1 address-download payload and crosswalk the five XRPL source accounts and XRP-BF2 backing address.
Build Bitbank XRP/JPY historical volume, spread and ±2% depth series before and after the October 1 acquisition.
Obtain actual SBI START bond XRP distribution totals and Visa Crypto Card XRP credit volumes if publicly disclosed.
Track JPYSC issuance, lending balances, short-JGB backing and any public-chain migration separately.
Track the December 31 trust merger approvals and post-merger digital-asset custody scope.
Monitor the JPYSC/OUSD PoC and BlackRock tokenized-MMF MOU for chain, asset, collateral and production evidence.
Continue USDC/RLUSD/OUSD supply and distribution comparisons without inferring XRP demand from stablecoin issuance.
prediction_policy: NOT_ISSUED until synchronized point-in-time market/flow features, leakage-safe walk-forward tests, baselines, calibration and shadow evaluation pass.
